title: NYC Digital Marketing Agency | NYC Search Marketing Services

facts.fact: Thrive states it has 20+ years of experience serving campaigns.
facts.quote: brings 20+ years of experience to campaigns that improve visibility

facts.fact: Thrive reports a 95% client retention rate on its own page.
The page displays a 7X count alongside an Inc. 5000 badge, with no further explanation of the figure.
Thrive's page cites over 1,000 client reviews, with a link to a reviews page.
The lead form's Estimated Monthly Budget options range from $2,500-$5,000 per month up to $50,000+ per month, and the page notes the budget excludes ad spend.
facts.quote: Budget does not include Ad spend

facts.fact: The lead form's Web Design Budget options range from $1,000-$5,000 up to $50,000+.
The lead form's Photography/Video Budget options range from $2,500-$10,000 up to $50,000+.
The lead form's Monthly Marketing Budget options range from under $750 to above $100,000.
The page offers a free proposal, which begins with a free consultation after the form is completed.
facts.quote: Click the button below for a free proposal

facts.fact: In a vendor-published case study, an in-house plumbing company client saw a 344% increase in search traffic and a 148% increase in online leads.
In a vendor-published case study, a roofing and construction client saw 2,000+ organic conversions and a 224% increase in new organic users.
A client testimonial on the page claims an SEO return on investment in the 800% range; this is the client's self-reported figure, not independently verified.
facts.quote: Since we started working with Thrive, our SEO return on investment is in the 800% range.

facts.fact: The vendor claims a #1 ranking in Google Search, Google Maps Search, and ChatGPT Search, with no date or methodology given.
